report.summary: One test failed. `test_invalid_book_is_rejected[blank-title]` got 201 instead of 422, because the API accepts a whitespace-only title. This is an application bug in `validate_book`. Fix that check first.

causes.title: Title validation accepts whitespace-only titles
causes.explanation: `validate_book` checks `not book.title`, which only rejects an empty string. A title of '   ' passes and the book is created with 201. The author check right below it uses `.strip()`, so the two checks are inconsistent. The test expects 422 and is correct.
causes.suggested_fix: Change the check in app/main.py:75 to `if not book.title.strip():`.
